contract: Version 0 sets metadata.version to 2 and version 1 raises it to 3.
A downgrade to 1 is rejected and the level stays 3.
Version 2 is rejected and does not change the level or the log directory.
Reopen restores level 3 and the log directory.
limits: Source, rustc, cluster id, and feature config are pinned by scripts/broker-upgrade-campaign.py into docs/evidence/broker/upgrade/campaign.json.
This is one local admin journal, not a multi-broker rolling upgrade or a mixed-version network.
Not a production qualification and not a fastest-server claim.
